Hi all. I don't have much to say about me, just someone. I am a photographer and make videos occasionally.

Yes, I "come" from Reddit. The recent events are not the reason I'm here though. It's more of a form of anxiety that could be better summarized as "if I comment nobody will see it anyway" or "mhh, the thread is still fresh, let's sterilize as much as possible my thoughts so that I'll have a chance to be visible". It is a very self-centered way of thinking, I admit, but please look past the appearance.

Wouldn't you want to feel, truly and honestly, like you contributed to a discussion? Have you started a conversation successfully and did it have a positive impact on you and the parties involved? Have you seen change?

That's why I joined this site, because it's fresh, with a relatively low userbase, and a good chance to get visibility. Like a big field and a bunch of people willing to plant seeds.

However, I can't deny that this reflects exactly what many other social media sites were in the beginning: the field will eventually become bigger, more farmers will arrive with more seeds, conflicts over resources and crop rotation will start, so the ones with unrepresented, unpopular views will move to the corner, never to be seen again. Eventually, the field won't be able to support so many plants and will dry up, killing everything and driving most of (if not all) the farmers away.

So I won't delude myself. This is the best time to join this community. Let me plant my tiny thoughts and we'll see how they grow :)
